def format_currency(n: int) -> str:
    if n < 0:
        sign = "-"
        n = -n
    else:
        sign = ""
    
    # Convert to string and insert commas every 3 digits from the right
    s = str(n)
    if len(s) <= 3:
        formatted = s
    else:
        # Split into groups of 3 from the right
        groups = []
        while len(s) > 3:
            groups.append(s[-3:])
            s = s[:-3]
        groups.append(s)
        groups.reverse()
        formatted = ",".join(groups)
    
    return f"{sign}${formatted}"
```
